newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips in X-ray venture with Andrex.
newsitem.headline: Philips in X-ray venture with Andrex.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Friday its industrial X-ray unit would form a venture with Denmark's Andrex AS.
Philips said it would become the major shareholder with a stake of 80 percent.
Philips said its unit involved in the venture was Philips Industrial X-ray GmbH of Hamburg.
The remaining 20 percent of the shares will be held by Andrex's parent NDT International AS of Copenhagen.
The new company will have a turnover of 70 million guilders and produce a whole range of industrial X-ray machines.
The transaction is expected to be completed in the second half of the year, subject to approval from German cartel authorities, and will result in a Hamburg-headquartered firm.
It will have some 180 staff in operations throughout Europe and the United States.
